name: wolf-pack-retaliates
comment: WP-2.3 task 1. Two wolves (ids 0, 1) and a pig (id 2) in the fenced stone pen of entity/sheep-shear, no player. t=5 the pig hits wolf 0 for 2 (attack op with attacker_id: EntityWolf.attackEntityFrom, EntityWolf.java:254-298): the wolf stands up, a non-player non-arrow attacker's damage is halved rounded up (1), EntityLiving's hit, then every untamed wolf without a target within 16x4x16 (both, the hit wolf included) targets the pig; not a player, so neither gets angry. t=10 a hit of 1 with no attacker on wolf 1: not halved, no retaliation, no anger. The wolves chase the pig (getPathToEntity, leaps) and bite it (2 points, EntityWolf.attackEntity) until it dies (health 0 at t = 81) and drops raw porkchops; EntityCreature then drops the dead target. t=40 save (Tier S): the wolves' Angry/Sitting/Owner (false, false, "") and health. Anger needs a player attacker (the player branch of the attack op is WP-2.5). rng_state and entity_state every tick.
